name: aurora-3
description: Aurora 3.0, an Astro-based evolution of the Aurora theme.

scripts.build: astro check && astro build && node scripts/copy-prism-assets.mjs && node scripts/copy-comment-assets.mjs && pagefind --site dist
scripts.demo:build: ASTRO_SITE=https://yanpuzhen.github.io ASTRO_BASE=/astro-theme-aurora/demo/ ASTRO_DEMO_BUILD=true PUBLIC_AURORA_DIA=true pnpm build
scripts.test:browser:cdn:dev: PLAYWRIGHT_DEV=true ASTRO_PREFLIGHT_TESTS=true ASTRO_CONFIG_FILE=tests/fixtures/config-cdn-cn.yml playwright test tests/browser/cdn-assets.spec.ts tests/browser/cdn.spec.ts --grep 'local CN|dev middleware|delayed Prism|optional assets|OwO and Cap'
scripts.test:preflight: pnpm test:preflight:config && pnpm test:preflight:comments && pnpm test:preflight:feeds && pnpm test:cdn && pnpm test:cdn:p2 && pnpm test:licenses
scripts.test:browser:preflight: ASTRO_PREFLIGHT_TESTS=true ASTRO_CONFIG_FILE=tests/fixtures/config-ui.yml pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_PATH=/config-smoke ASTRO_CONFIG_FILE=tests/fixtures/config-ui.yml playwright test tests/browser/preflight.spec.ts
scripts.test:browser:giscus: ASTRO_CONFIG_FILE=tests/fixtures/config-giscus.yml pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_PATH=/giscus-smoke ASTRO_CONFIG_FILE=tests/fixtures/config-giscus.yml playwright test tests/browser/giscus.spec.ts
scripts.test:browser:cdn:en: ASTRO_PREFLIGHT_TESTS=true ASTRO_CONFIG_FILE=tests/fixtures/config-cdn-en.yml pnpm build && playwright test tests/browser/cdn-en.spec.ts
scripts.test:browser:cdn:cn: ASTRO_PREFLIGHT_TESTS=true ASTRO_CONFIG_FILE=tests/fixtures/config-cdn-cn.yml pnpm build && playwright test tests/browser/cdn.spec.ts
scripts.test: node scripts/verify-build.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-rc.mjs && pnpm test:preflight
